name: Kyonyuu Gakkyuu Iinchou no Oshigoto
original_name: 巨乳学級委員長のお仕事
source:
A story about a day of a busty class president.
No before-story or option, just choose the scene you wish to view.

Various naughty classes with the dedicated class president!
Naughty reading, art or sport classes, lunch or after-school activity?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ062791.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一部描绘巨乳班长日常一天的作品。
没有冗长的前置铺垫与复杂选项，直接挑选你想观赏的场景即可畅享。

与尽职尽责的班长一起度过花样百出的色色课堂时光！
究竟要选色色的阅读课、美术课、体育课，还是午休时间抑或放学后的秘密活动呢？
